entities.summary: Alexandr Zaichikov is a Belarusian-born Kazakh weightlifter. He competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the –105 kg event, and in the same event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He won a Bronze medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
